data.description:
### Video
- **S01** - JPBD
- **ONA** - CR

**As for filtering:**
The usual stuff; Denoise, AA, Deband, Regrain, etc.
A proper rescale for both 720p and 812p scenes in the series
‎
### Audio
- Japanese 2.0 FLAC (USBD TrueHD -> FLAC)
- English 5.1 FLAC (USBD TrueHD -> FLAC)
- ONA: Japanese AAC (CR)
### Subs - S01
- English [Astral] including a lot of fixes I had to do myself (Full and Signs Tracks)
- German [Chinurarete] retimed to BD and with translated [Astral] TS
### Subs - ONA
- English [[Spaghetti]](https://nyaa.si/view/1400265) (restyled and added the ED myself)
- German (restyled CR)

‎
[MediaInfo](https://bin.disroot.org/?e379fc1c27d884f6#GjwdjWgKw5cpd76z8qfwGsDiivViDMDYJZfG3PajaJk2)

‎
#### Other Info
The ONA is supposed to be watched after S01 and before watching [the movie](https://nyaa.si/view/1465140) (which is a direct sequel)
~~It kinda doesn't matter to the story tho and I only did it for the free AB upload~~
